narr: Thunderstorms produced locally heavy rain in eastern Pennsylvania from the late afternoon into the nighttime hours of June 26. Rainfall totals were as high as 2 to 5 inches.
ev: Widespread roadway flooding around the Exton Square Mall in Exton with some water rescues taking place.
Minor flooding occurred along Wissahickon Creek in Philadelphia.
There were several road closures in Tatamy due to flooding. At least one vehicle was stranded in the flood waters.
Minor flooding occurred along Crum Creek in Edgmont Township and Newtown Township.
Moderate flooding occurred along the East Branch of the Brandywine Creek in West Bradford Township and East Bradford Township.
East Gay Street was closed due to flooding at Montgomery Avenue along the West Chester and West Goshen Township line.
Flooding lead to a water rescue on the US Route 30 eastbound ramp onto US Route 202 northbound in West Whiteland Township.
Minor flooding occurred along Chester Creek in Aston Township, Middletown Township and Brookhaven.
